title: Great App but please add lock screen widget
body: I love this app and it’s a great way to visually see your progress. However can you guys please add a lock screen widget showing how many tasks you have done based off of how many you have set. Like a 1/7 just so you can see how many are left for the day 🙏
author: NVCANTFORGET

title: Exactly what I needed
body: For a long time I tried to find a habit tracking app that worked for me. All the options I tried were lacking features here or there that I was looking for. HabitKit fixed that for me. Support is also very available and supporting when I have raised requests
author: 0472763hfhwjdbfj

title: Fantastic
body:
This app is seamless. I’ve been using it every day for over a year now, and that alone shows how well the simple UI and functionality work. It makes habit tracking feel easy and natural.

One small request: it’d be great to have an option to hide completed habits. My list is getting long, and scrolling past checked items slows things down. Thanks for continuing to improve the app!
author: Chris.jvr

title: Just started
